news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹52.22 (up from ₹21.96 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹24.3b (up 103% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹13.3b (up 138% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 55% (up from 47% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 8.1%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 3.7%. Revenue is forecast to grow 16% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 15% growth forecast for the Capital Markets industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 86% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 126% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
